subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue remain the combined Control UI umbrella for structured reply metadata plus no-output completion semantics, or should maintainers split it behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol shape, agent runtime metadata semantics, channel reply context, and final-delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or tracker split.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review or replace the structured reply-metadata PR and settle the final fallback delivery policy.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm the reply-metadata PR or issue and the final-delivery issue fully own both halves.

options.title: Narrow To Current Quote UI
options.body: Treat Markdown quote behavior as enough for Control UI replies and explicitly defer structured reply metadata to channel/runtime contract issues.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review or replace the structured reply-metadata PR and settle the final fallback delivery policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the broadest observed history across the UI send flow, prompt envelope, and incomplete-turn/fallback surfaces involved in this product choice.
